title: event_schema.json (S7 output)
description: architecture.md S7: 'event_schema.json (versioned; OTel GenAI + extensions)'. Versioning follows OTel's own discipline (S7 prose): an oah.* extension attribute is Development or Stable (nothing in between), a breaking rename ships alongside the old name for a stated dual-emission window, consumers pin to a schema version. gen_ai.* attributes are all Development stability as of the live check in docs/decisions/001-sp6-otel-genai-semconv-maturity.md -- stamped per attribute, not assumed to stay that way forever.

semconv_pin.description: The open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-genai commit/tag this schema's otel_genai attributes were designed against -- run_manifest.json's own semconv_pin field, echoed here for a standalone reader of event_schema.json who doesn't have the manifest.

stability.description: oah_extension attributes start development and are promoted deliberately, never automatically. otel_genai attributes inherit upstream stability -- currently always development per SP6's live check, stamped here rather than looked up fresh every time a schema is read.

deprecated_by.description: Set when stability is deprecated -- the replacement attribute name, per the dual-emission-window discipline. Both names must appear in attributes[] during the window.

source_lenses.description: Which S4 lens(es) designed this attribute -- more than one lens can independently produce the same attribute name.
